lines.zh: 我走不了，我被挂在叶上。
lines.en: I can't walk. I'm hung from a leaf.
I sway. The wind pushes me.
My whole body is wrapped in a shell.

lines.zh: 我在叶背下面，晃动很小。
lines.en: Under the leaf. My sway is slight.
I cannot move an inch.
Inside I'm changing. Outside I'm still.
One thread holds me. Strong.
I'm wedged between stem and leaf.
The wind turned me a little.
In this state, I don't walk.
I turn slowly with the sun.

lines.zh: 我挂在原处，一根丝的事。
lines.en: Hanging where I was left. One thread's work.
Rain drums on my shell.
My sway is small. The thread holds.
I don't walk. I wait.
I swing with the branch.
Wrapped. Perfectly still.
Something is growing inside.

lines.zh: 我的壳是半透明的，能看见一点。
lines.en: My shell is half clear. Something shows.
This pose must last a long time.
No mouth. I can't speak.
A bird nearby. I hold everything in.
Loud outside. Quiet in here.
Reassembling. Slowly.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶背面，看不见天。
lines.en: Under the leaf. No sky.
A few fine lines on my shell.
I can't move. Only wait.
Day after day. No change visible.

lines.zh: 你看我，我什么也做不了。
lines.en: You look at me. I can do nothing.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来了，我要被拿走了？
lines.en: You're reaching. Am I being taken?

lines.zh: 我挂在这儿，你没有发现。
lines.en: I hang here. You didn't notice.
Touch me and I fall.

lines.zh: 你隔着壳看，我也在看你。
lines.en: You look through the shell; I look back.

lines.zh: 你能看见里面的形状吗？
lines.en: Can you see the shape inside?

lines.zh: 我还没准备好，你就要拆我？
lines.en: I'm not ready. You'd open me?
Your face, one layer of shell away.
I'm looking at you from in here.
This shouldn't be picked.

lines.zh: 丝断了一根，我往下坠半寸。
lines.en: One thread snapped; I sag half an inch.
Swinging hard. The thread's nearly gone.

lines.zh: 我里面的东西缩了一下。
lines.en: What's inside me flinched.
I can't move. I just take it.
Stop. I'll fall.
This shell won't take many hits.
One thread loosened.
The shape inside is disturbed.
I hear it from inside. Muffled.
You interrupted the process.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶上，什么也做不了。
lines.en: Hanging on a leaf, I can do nothing.
Bringing leaves won't help.
I'm not waiting for food.

lines.zh: 我没有口器，摆什么也没用。
lines.en: I have no mouthparts; nothing you set out matters.

lines.zh: 你把叶子挂在这里，倒是奇怪。
lines.en: Hanging a leaf here. Odd.
Waiting on time, not a meal.
Don't sway about beside me.

lines.zh: 壳里的我要变了，跟这个没关系。
lines.en: What's inside is changing. Unrelated.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西会招虫子。
lines.en: That will draw insects.

lines.zh: 丝壳里，我连嘴都用不上。
lines.en: Inside this silk I can't even use my mouth.
You touched the branch. I'm swinging.
A bit of silk came loose.
Don't push. This shell is thin.

lines.zh: 我转了一圈，又慢慢停住。
lines.en: I spun a full turn and slowly stopped.

lines.zh: 你挨得这么近，我几乎不动。
lines.en: You're close. I hardly move.
A mark on my shell.
I hang here. You ran into me.
Stop shaking this bough.

lines.zh: 丝很有韧性，没那么容易断。
lines.en: The silk is tough. Not easy to break.

lines.zh: 你的袖子擦过，我的壳转半圈。
lines.en: Your sleeve brushes by; my shell turns half a circle.
At this stage, I have none of that.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶上，不能靠近谁。
lines.en: Hung from a leaf. I can't approach anyone.

lines.zh: 你想跟我说话？我只是个壳。
lines.en: Talking to me? I'm only a shell.

lines.zh: 等我出来，那才是另一个我。
lines.en: When I emerge, that's someone else.
Look for the butterfly instead.
I know nothing of the outside.

lines.zh: 我这一段时间都算沉睡。
lines.en: This whole stretch counts as sleep.
Back off. Leave my thread.

lines.zh: 树上还有很多别的东西。
lines.en: There's much else in this tree.
If you wait, it will be long.
I can't pick anything up.

lines.zh: 你放在这里，我也带不走。
lines.en: Leave it here. I can't carry it either.

lines.zh: 这东西挂在我旁边，很怪。
lines.en: Hanging beside me. Strange.
No hands. Only a shell.
It covers part of me.
The leaf moves. So do I.
Don't hang it on me.
The silk will catch it.
It's blocking my thread.
Take it. It might break my line.

lines.zh: 叶柄传来爪子抓挠的震动。
lines.en: Claws scratch at the stem; the tremors reach me.
The leaf shivers; I tense up first.
I can't flee. Only wait.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡住了我的叶。
lines.en: Your shadow covered my leaf.
What's inside me woke.
You're standing beneath me. Perfect.

lines.zh: 这一层壳，现在是我的全部。
lines.en: This shell is all I have now.
You came too early.
I don't have wings yet.
Hear anything inside the shell?
Let's say I'm preparing.
The lines on my shell are darkening.

lines.zh: 我再等一会儿，就出来了。
lines.en: A little longer and I'll be out.
Don't go. Stand there.
My shell is softening.
Movement inside. Nothing outside yet.
Two steps back. Noted.
My wings are already folded inside the shell.
One last thread holds me.
Hear that cracking?
I drop on your head. Lightly.
My shell edge is prickly.
No strength. Only weight.

lines.zh: 我撞在你肩上的时候裂了。
lines.en: I cracked on impact with your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下是我唯一的一下。
lines.en: That was my only blow.

lines.zh: 我粘在你衣服上，扯不掉。
lines.en: I stuck to your clothes. Can't be pulled off.

lines.zh: 我里面的东西动了一下。
lines.en: Something inside me shifted.
Don't squeeze. I'd shatter.

lines.zh: 我压在你手指上，纹路硌人。
lines.en: On your finger. The ridges bite.
After that touch, I should change.
A caterpillar made this on a leaf.
I'm hung up. The thread is fine.
I haven't taken shape yet.

lines.zh: 叶背下面多了一个绿色的包。
lines.en: A green packet under the leaf.
I hang there, quietly.

lines.zh: 这是我最后的样子之一。
lines.en: This is one of my last shapes.

lines.zh: 我在叶脉之间固定好了。
lines.en: Anchored between the veins.
That thread took me a long while.
I shouldn't be disturbed.
The shell starts soft.

lines.zh: 火烤到壳上，里面开始烫。
lines.en: Fire on the shell. It's getting hot inside.

lines.zh: 掉到地上，壳上裂开一道。
lines.en: Hit the ground. A split in the shell.
Water seeped in. I'm suffocating.

lines.zh: 气浪把我和叶子一起掀了。
lines.en: The blast flung me and the leaf.
Something went through the shell.

lines.zh: 这光让里面的变化停了。
lines.en: That light stopped the change inside.

lines.zh: 我靠之前存的，快用完了。
lines.en: Living on what I stored. Nearly gone.

lines.zh: 雷光照透了壳，里面全亮。
lines.en: Lightning lit straight through the shell.
The thread broke. I'm falling.
